These similarities are generic administrative mechanisms, however, and do not show that any candidate supplied a material template for an order authorizing the Secretary of State to prescribe regulations.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"authorizing the secretary state prescribe rules and regulations","parent_excerpt":"The Civil Service Commission is authorized, after consultation with the Department of State, to prescribe such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this order","explanation":"This is the closest verbal and functional parallel, but it assigns rulemaking to a different body and reflects routine enabling language rather than a distinctive template."},{"child_excerpt":"authorizing the secretary state","parent_excerpt":"The authority to consult with representatives of industry, business, and agriculture ... is delegated severally to the Secretary of the Interior, the Secretary of Agriculture, the Secretary of Commerce, and the Director of the Office of Defense Transportation","explanation":"Both concern presidential authorization of executive officials, but the delegated powers and administrative scheme are materially different."},{"child_excerpt":"authorizing the secretary state","parent_excerpt":"are hereby authorized, as to their respective agencies, to exercise the authority vested in the President","explanation":"This is another general delegation formulation, without distinctive language or machinery tying it to the child."}]}
